title: Nvidia Hit With Suit Over AI Training Music Data
source_used: Law360 (opening line only, from the page description)
quote_evidence: An independent music licensing company has brought a lawsuit accusing Nvidia of infringing its copyrights to train its artificial intelligence models, days after dropping a nearly identical suit in the same court.
why_it_matters_hint: A music licensing company says Nvidia trained AI models on its copyrighted music.
notes: Law360 article is behind a subscription; only the opening sentence (page description) was available. No other outlet found carrying the story (several Google News searches). The company, court and music involved are not known.
